title: Guna Yala y el mar creciente: Autonomía ancestral y desafío climático
goal: Explore Guna Yala's autonomous indigenous governance (Revolución Dule 1925, molas, sailas) and its pioneering climate resettlement facing sea-level rise.
grammar: Autonomía comarcal indígena y cambio climático en Panamá

sections.title: Unit 8: Panama — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 8 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Panama: The Interoceanic Crossroads, Global Commerce & Afro-Antillean Identity.

In this lesson, we study guna yala y el mar creciente: autonomía ancestral y desafío climático, evaluating Panama's physical geography, sovereignty struggles, cultural pluralism, and economic paradoxes.

items: Explore Guna Yala's autonomous indigenous governance (Revolución Dule 1925, molas, sailas) and its pioneering climate resettlement facing sea-level rise.
Master the lexicon and discourse of pueblos-indigenas-comarcas-panama.
